envelope.description: Free-form lookup: size, the failure bridge and single-pass normalisation

body.title: Free-form lookup: size, the failure bridge and single-pass normalisation
body.summary: Pass the request size to runFinalStructuredEmit through the tool loop and move it onto the helper; make the free-form lookup carry every ShaperAnswerStepFailedError as a LookupFailedError with its data, handling and answerStepReason, have failedOutput copy the reason as errorCode 'answer-step:<reason>', and copy handling in extractSoleFreeformResult. Normalise a single-pass final-emit failure (ShaperLlmUnavailableError, ShaperSchemaUnrecoverable) into the same reason-preserving bridge so the gathered findings are kept and no second synthesis runs (finding 4).
acceptanceChecks: HandlingBudgetError, model-failed and invalid-answer each reach the answer-step failure with their reason and the report through the real executor and context driver
an admitted XS or S conversation whose final emission fails by transport or by an invalid reply keeps its tool results and ends in the terminal answer-step failure with no second synthesis attempt
a conversation that fits at size S returns directly with single-pass handling and at size M is divided

tests.name: freeform-handling.test.ts: size reaches runFinalStructuredEmit; fits at S returns directly with single-pass handling; at M divided although it fits

freeform-handling.test.ts: HandlingBudgetError, model-failed and invalid-answer become LookupFailedError with tool results, handling and answerStepReason, errorCode 'answer-step:<reason>', through executePlan with no second synthesis
freeform-handling.test.ts: single-pass final-emit failure (ShaperLlmUnavailableError, ShaperSchemaUnrecoverable) is normalised into the bridge and keeps findings
